tickets.name: The Opener
tickets.note: Thunder at Cavaliers, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! It starts with Allen against Hartenstein at center court, and our money says Allen gets up there first! That puts the Cavaliers on the front foot to get on the board first. And if the Thunder flip the script, Hartenstein is waiting right there to pounce! Only one man in this game beats his price, and it's Hartenstein. Let's go!

tickets.name: Tip Drill
tickets.note: Hawks roll into Pacers territory, and the first minute is all we care about! Okongwu and Huff meet at center court, and it's anybody's tip! Either side can strike first here, and that's exactly why we've got both ends covered! Tip it, run it, finish it. If Okongwu gets that jump, that's the whole plan! Should the Pacers grab the first possession, Huff is our trigger man! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!
